hero.label: Made for Santé
hero.headline: I want to help Santé put modern POS in every liquor store.
hero.subheadline: Darren and Antoine built Santé to free up liquor store owners to do what they love, and I want to be the person opening those doors. Having run cold outreach and pipeline generation for an early-stage AI startup, I know what it takes to earn trust with small business owners who have never heard of you. A YC-backed product with a clear wedge in a fragmented market is exactly the kind of opportunity I am looking for at the start of my career.

whyCompany.title: Liquor retail is massively underserved by modern software
whyCompany.body: Most independent liquor stores are still running on legacy POS systems that were not built for the complexity of wine and spirits inventory, compliance, or customer loyalty. Santé's all-in-one approach gives owners a real reason to switch, which means the conversation is not just about price but about transforming how they run their business. That is a much more compelling sell.

whyCompany.title: Santé is at the exact moment where outbound matters most
whyCompany.body: With 10 employees and 7 open roles, Santé is in the phase where every new customer genuinely moves the needle and where a hungry BDR can have outsized impact. YC backing means the product and team have been validated, but the real pipeline-building work is still ahead. Getting in now means I would be shaping how Santé goes to market from the ground up.

whyCompany.title: I have done this exact job for an early-stage startup before
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built outbound sequences from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn, and helped the company acquire 15 to 20 paying clients through cold outreach with no brand recognition to lean on. More recently at NextAfter I learned how to frame value propositions for niche B2B audiences who need to be educated before they convert. Both of those experiences map directly to what Santé needs right now.

quote: Santé is solving a real problem for a specific type of owner who has been ignored by software for decades, and I want to be the one making the calls that puts them on the map. This is not a role I am applying to because it is available; it is the role I have been building toward.
